description: This file contains utility functions and mixins for Bootstrap's styling system, including evaluation of maps, color manipulation, contrast calculations, and other helper functions used for styling and responsive design.

methods.name: _assert-ascending
methods.description: Mixin to ensure that a Sass map is in ascending order, with warnings if not.

methods.name: _assert-starts-at-zero
methods.description: Mixin to verify that the first breakpoint starts at zero, with a warning if it does not.

methods.name: to-rgb
methods.description: Function to convert a color value to its RGB components.

methods.name: rgba-css-var
methods.description: Function to generate an RGBA CSS variable string based on input identifiers and targets.

methods.name: map-loop
methods.description: Function to apply a specified function to each entry in a Sass map, returning a new map.

methods.name: varify
methods.description: Function that creates a string of CSS variable references from a list.

methods.name: negativify-map
methods.description: Internal function to generate a negative variant of a Sass map with keys prefixed by 'n'.

methods.name: map-get-multiple
methods.description: Retrieve multiple entries from a Sass map given a list of keys.

methods.name: map-merge-multiple
methods.description: Merge multiple Sass maps into a single map.

methods.name: str-replace
methods.description: Function to replace all instances of a substring within a string.

methods.name: escape-svg
methods.description: Function to encode SVG strings for safe embedding in CSS, especially data URIs.

methods.name: color-contrast
methods.description: Determines a suitable foreground color based on background contrast requirements.

methods.name: contrast-ratio
methods.description: Calculates the contrast ratio between two colors based on luminance.

methods.name: luminance
methods.description: Computes the relative luminance of a color per WCAG guidelines.

methods.name: opaque
methods.description: Creates an opaque color by blending a foreground over a background.

methods.name: tint-color
methods.description: Returns a lighter version of a color by mixing with white.

methods.name: shade-color
methods.description: Returns a darker version of a color by mixing with black.

methods.name: shift-color
methods.description: Shades or tints a color depending on the weight's sign.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Performs an addition of two CSS values, with optional calc syntax.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Performs subtraction of two CSS values, with optional calc syntax.

methods.name: divide
methods.description: Divides two numbers with specified precision, preserving units.
